name: Yurimoto Yuna
source:
Secretary to the president of Kijima System Co., Ltd.
She lives in the Kijima household and also looks after their private life.

After graduating from junior college, she worked as a secretary to the president of another company, but due to various circumstances she became a secretary at Kijima System and started living with the Kijima household.

She has a calm personality and rarely gets emotional, and treats everyone equally.
She is very polite and competent in her work, and has a good reputation with clients, and is often called upon by members of meetings, etc.

She has a younger brother, but he suffers from an incurable disease and is constantly hospitalized.
